content: <thought>We have the 13C NMR data showing eight distinct carbon signals: a carbonyl carbon at ~167 ppm, two sp² carbons at ~144 ppm and ~130 ppm, two equivalent aliphatic carbons at ~34.5 ppm, and three other aliphatic carbons at ~22.8, 21.4, and 19.2 ppm. This pattern suggests a C₈ molecule containing one carbonyl (likely a ketone) and one C=C double bond (α,β‑unsaturated ketone). To confirm the molecular formula and narrow down the structure, the cheapest next step is to obtain the mass spectrum, which will give the exact molecular weight without needing a SMILES input.
